0.why: ComputerscareDebug.cpp:417 takes getChannels() on this input and ComputerscareDebug.cpp:436 reads every channel with getVoltage(i) into the log

1.why: ComputerscareDebug.cpp:418 takes getChannels() on this input and ComputerscareDebug.cpp:565 reads each channel into a Rack dsp::SchmittTrigger at its default 1V high threshold

2.why: ComputerscareDebug.cpp:593 reads this jack with getVoltage, channel 0 only, divides the voltage by two and hands the result to a Rack dsp::SchmittTrigger left at its defaults of 1V high and 0V low; because of the halving the jack itself has to climb above 2V to fire and fall back below 0V to rearm, so an ordinary 1V trigger never reaches it. Each firing writes zero into all sixteen logged lines and puts the display back to its default row of zeros.
